drawing_refinement_proposed.what: the I2C1 pair must be drawn as a GROUP at the boundary
drawing_refinement_proposed.why: line 4 gave I2C1_SDA two independent single-net landings at the (51.5,61.905)/(51.5,67.455) corner; the read-out shows several 0.1-0.7mm I2C1_SDA fragments clustered there and I2C1_SCL became a NEW residual in the same corner. Two independent single-net landings interfere; the sec.20 EVM policy for a bus pair is one corridor carrying the group (long runs straight, one layer change per group).
drawing_refinement_proposed.proposed: draw lines 4 as a PAIR: one corridor of width >= 2 nets + clearance at the corner, two landings spaced by the netclass pitch, one shared layer-change. Deterministic; a boundary-condition change to the spec, not a search.
